schema.name: read_function_module_interface
schema.description: Read one active function module interface and source through the SAP repository helper. Read-only and allowed for customer or standard function modules. Preserves raw updateTaskMode; updateTask is true for any noninitial update mode, including numeric SAP modes, not only X. Mode validity/meaning is not inferred. Returns a deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint; includeExecutionSupport additionally resolves scalar, flat-structure, and table parameter shapes through DDIC.

{

  "source": [
    "FUNCTION view_authority_check.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(VIEW_ACTION) DEFAULT 'U'",
    "*\"     VALUE(VIEW_NAME) LIKE  DD25V-VIEWNAME",
    "*\"     VALUE(NO_WARNING_FOR_CLIENTINDEP) DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(CHECK_ACTION_ALTERNATIVE) TYPE  FLAG OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(GRANTED_ACTVT) TYPE  ACTIV_AUTH",
    "*\"  CHANGING",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(ORG_CRIT_INST) TYPE  VIMTY_OC_TYPE OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      INVALID_ACTION",
    "*\"      NO_AUTHORITY",
    "*\"      NO_CLIENTINDEPENDENT_AUTHORITY",
    "*\"      TABLE_NOT_FOUND",
    "*\"      NO_LINEDEPENDENT_AUTHORITY",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* Note 1522661",
    "* - new optional parameters CHECK_ACTION_ALTERNATIVE and GRANTED_ACTVT",
    "*   to check display activity if the update check was failed",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* Note 1539105",
    "* - write a sec-audit log entry with view_name and planed activity, if",
    "*   that module is indirectly called per RFC and the sec-audit log is",
    "*   activated",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  CONSTANTS:",
    "    lc_true       TYPE sap_bool     VALUE 'X',",
    "    lc_failed     TYPE activ_auth   VALUE '00',",
    "    lc_no_tddat   TYPE tddat-cclass VALUE '&NC&'.",
    "",
    "  DATA:",
    "    customauth      TYPE dd25v-customauth,",
    "    cliindep        TYPE dd02v-clidep,",
    "    activity        TYPE xuval,",
    "    lv_delcl        TYPE char1,",
    "    ld_2nd_chk      TYPE flag,",
    "    ld_chk_result   TYPE activ_auth,",
    "    lc_auth_grp     TYPE tddat-cclass,",
    "    auth_enh_active TYPE char1,",
    "    roottab         TYPE dd25l-roottab,",
    "    dd02v_roottab   TYPE dd02v,",
    "    lb_ae           TYPE REF TO if_ex_vim_ae_badi.",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* verify parameters",
    "  CASE view_action.",
    "    WHEN 'U' OR 'T'.  \"update or transport",
    "      activity = '02'.",
    "      IF check_action_alternative = 'X'.",
    "        ld_2nd_chk = lc_true.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "    WHEN 'S'.         \"show",
    "      activity = '03'.",
    "",
    "    WHEN OTHERS.",
    "      RAISE invalid_action.",
    "",
    "  ENDCASE.",
    "",
    "  IF view_name NE last_view OR view_name IS INITIAL. \"20041230 UF",
    "    PERFORM prepare USING view_name.                        \"1522661/2",
    "    last_view = view_name.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'RSAU_WRITE_RFCTABLE_AUDIT_LOG'       \"note 1539105",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      id_table       = view_name",
    "      id_actvt       = activity.",
    "",
    "  IF tvdir-bastab EQ space             \"view",
    "   OR dd25l-viewname <> dd25l-roottab. \"viewvariant on base table",
    "    MOVE dd25l-customauth TO customauth.",
    "*   IF X030L-CLPOS NE 1.",
    "    IF x030l-flagbyte Z vim_clidep.",
    "      MOVE 'X' TO cliindep.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      CLEAR cliindep.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ELSE.                                \"base table",
    "    IF dd02v-clidep EQ space.",
    "      MOVE: 'X' TO cliindep,",
    "            dd02v-contflag TO customauth.",
    "*   ELSEIF TEXT_TAB_EXISTS NE SPACE AND TEXT_X030L-CLPOS NE 1. \"texttb",
    "    ELSEIF text_tab_exists NE space AND",
    "           text_x030l-flagbyte Z vim_clidep. \"texttb",
    "      MOVE 'X' TO cliindep.",
    "      SELECT * FROM dd02l WHERE tabname  EQ text_table_name",
    "                            AND as4local EQ 'A'.",
    "        EXIT.",
    "      ENDSELECT.",
    "      IF sy-subrc NE 0. RAISE table_not_found. ENDIF.",
    "      MOVE dd02l-contflag TO customauth.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      MOVE dd02v-contflag TO customauth.                   \"SRE 1276656",
    "      CLEAR cliindep.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  PERFORM internal_s_tabu_nam_check USING activity        \"note 1481950",
    "                                          view_name.",
    "",
    "  CALL METHOD cl_exithandler=>get_instance         \"#EC CI_BADI_GETINST",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      null_instance_accepted        = seex_false",
    "      exit_name                     = 'VIM_AE_BADI'",
    "    CHANGING",
    "      instance                      = lb_ae",
    "    EXCEPTIONS",
    "      no_reference                  = 1",
    "      no_interface_reference        = 2",
    "      no_exit_interface             = 3",
    "      class_not_implement_interface = 4",
    "      single_exit_multiply_active   = 5",
    "      cast_error                    = 6",
    "      exit_not_existing             = 7",
    "      data_incons_in_exit_managem   = 8",
    "      OTHERS                        = 9.",
    "  IF sy-subrc NE 0.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE * FROM tddat WHERE tabname = view_name.",
    "    IF sy-subrc NE 0  OR  tddat-cclass EQ space.",
    "      tddat-cclass = lc_no_tddat.             \" 'non classified table'",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    PERFORM check_s_tabu_dis_nam USING activity",
    "                                       tddat-cclass",
    "                                       view_name",
    "                                       ld_2nd_chk",
    "                              CHANGING ld_chk_result.",
    "    IF ld_chk_result = lc_failed.",
    "      RAISE no_authority.",
    "    ELSEIF ld_2nd_chk = lc_true.",
    "      granted_actvt = ld_chk_result.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    CALL METHOD lb_ae->get_ae_values",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "        ae_enabled = auth_enh_active",
    "        auth_grp   = lc_auth_grp.",
    "    IF auth_enh_active = 'X'.",
    "*     check enhanced table maintenance authority",
    "      lv_delcl = customauth.",
    "      IF lv_delcl IS INITIAL.",
    "        SELECT SINGLE roottab FROM dd25l INTO roottab       \"#EC *",
    "                              WHERE viewname  EQ view_name.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_GET'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            name     = roottab",
    "            langu    = sy-langu",
    "          IMPORTING",
    "            dd02v_wa = dd02v_roottab",
    "          EXCEPTIONS",
    "            OTHERS   = 0.",
    "        MOVE dd02v_roottab-contflag TO lv_delcl.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "      IF 'CGE' CS lv_delcl.                  \"Add E type also",
    "*                       It's a customizing table/view         \"SRE 2008",
    "        PERFORM check_s_tabu_dis_nam USING activity",
    "                                           lc_auth_grp",
    "                                           view_name",
    "                                           ld_2nd_chk",
    "                                  CHANGING ld_chk_result.",
    "        IF ld_chk_result = lc_failed.",
    "          RAISE no_authority.",
    "        ELSEIF ld_2nd_chk = lc_true.",
    "          granted_actvt = ld_chk_result.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "",
    "      ELSE.",
    "* Correction for Security issue - DUTTAN 25/11/2009.",
    "        SELECT SINGLE * FROM tddat WHERE tabname = view_name.",
    "        IF sy-subrc NE 0  OR  tddat-cclass EQ space.",
    "          tddat-cclass = lc_no_tddat.           \" 'non classified table'",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        PERFORM check_s_tabu_dis_nam USING activity",
    "                                           tddat-cclass",
    "                                           view_name",
    "                                           ld_2nd_chk",
    "                                  CHANGING ld_chk_result.",
    "        IF ld_chk_result = lc_failed.",
    "          RAISE no_authority.",
    "        ELSEIF ld_2nd_chk = lc_true.",
    "          granted_actvt = ld_chk_result.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "* End of Correction.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "*     check normal table maintenance authority",
    "      SELECT SINGLE * FROM tddat WHERE tabname = view_name.",
    "      IF sy-subrc NE 0  OR  tddat-cclass EQ space.",
    "        tddat-cclass = lc_no_tddat.             \" 'non classified table'",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      PERFORM check_s_tabu_dis_nam USING activity",
    "                                         tddat-cclass",
    "                                         view_name",
    "                                         ld_2nd_chk",
    "                                CHANGING ld_chk_result.",
    "      IF ld_chk_result = lc_failed.",
    "        RAISE no_authority.",
    "      ELSEIF ld_2nd_chk = lc_true.",
    "        granted_actvt = ld_chk_result.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.                                                    \"IG 1030838",
    "  IF cliindep NE space.                \"client independent view/table",
    "* check for customizing relevant clientindep tables.............*",
    "*   IF ACTIVITY EQ '02' AND     \"update request and",
    "*      ( CUSTOMAUTH CO SAP_CUST_CLASSES OR  \"special delivery classes",
    "*        CUSTOMAUTH CO CUST_ONLY_CLASSES ).",
    "    IF activity EQ '02'.               \"update request",
    "      AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_CLI'",
    "                ID 'CLIIDMAINT' FIELD 'X'.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.                \"not allowed",
    "        MESSAGE ID 'TB' TYPE 'I' NUMBER 109       \"no cli-indep auth",
    "        RAISING no_clientindependent_authority.",
    "*     ELSE.",
    "*       MESSAGE ID 'TB' TYPE 'I' NUMBER 113 .     \"warning cli-indep",
    "      ELSEIF no_warning_for_clientindep EQ space.",
    "        MESSAGE ID 'TB' TYPE 'I' NUMBER 113 .     \"warning cli-indep",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.                               \"client independent view/table",
    "",
    "  CHECK org_crit_inst IS REQUESTED.",
    "*>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>",
    "*  check sy-uname = 'FRENZELU' or sy-uname = 'UFTEST'.",
    "*>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>",
    "  IF NOT org_crit_inst IS INITIAL.",
    "    IF org_crit_inst->view_name <> view_name.",
    "      CLEAR org_crit_inst.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF org_crit_inst IS INITIAL.",
    "    CREATE OBJECT org_crit_inst",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        view_name             = view_name",
    "        activity              = activity",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        no_restrictions_by_oc = 1",
    "        no_oc_found           = 2.",
    "*                 view_not_found       = 3",
    "*                 oc_error             = 4.",
    "    CASE sy-subrc.",
    "      WHEN 0.",
    "",
    "      WHEN 1 OR 2.",
    "* organisation criterion not relevant",
    "        CLEAR org_crit_inst.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF NOT org_crit_inst IS INITIAL.",
    "    CALL METHOD org_crit_inst->check_oc_auth_gen",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        activity            = activity",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        no_auth             = 1",
    "        parameter_error     = 2",
    "        authorisation_error = 3",
    "        OTHERS              = 4.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      IF activity = svorg_read.",
    "        MESSAGE e755 RAISING no_linedependent_authority",
    "         WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.",
    "*   Sie haben keine zeilenbezogene Anzeigeberechtigung für diese Tabell",
    "      ELSE.",
    "        MESSAGE e756 RAISING no_linedependent_authority",
    "         WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.",
    "*   Sie haben keine zeilenbezogene Pflegeberechtigung für diese Tabell",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "ENDFUNCTION.",
    "",
    "",
    "*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*&      Form  internal_s_tabu_nam_check               ( Note 1481950 )",
    "*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* we need the S_TABU_NAM auth-check in SAP internal systems, also if",
    "* S_TABU_DIS authorization grants the user, to get a trace entry in",
    "* table USOB_AUTHVALTRACE (for SU22 maintenance)",
    "*---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* 09.05.2011   D033600  ( Note 1587228 )                        7.00+",
    "* - run the dummy check in every system, where the SU22 trace is active",
    "*---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "FORM internal_s_tabu_nam_check USING pd_actvt TYPE xuval",
    "                                     pd_table TYPE dd25v-viewname.",
    "",
    "  IF cl_su2x_tools=>get_status_su22_trace( ) = 'X' .",
    "    AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_NAM'",
    "             ID 'ACTVT' FIELD pd_actvt",
    "             ID 'TABLE' FIELD pd_table.",
    "    IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "      \"it's only a dummy auth-check for SU22 trace, the result is",
    "      \"not needed here",
    "      RETURN.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "ENDFORM.                    \"internal_s_tabu_nam_check",
    "",
    "*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*&      Form  check_s_tabu_dis_nam",
    "*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* Note 1481950",
    "* check will be performed if the user authorizations for S_TABU_DIS",
    "* are not enough for the action on that view. If the check against",
    "* S_TABU_NAM is also failed, we have to raise no_authority",
    "*",
    "* Note 1522661",
    "* IF the parameter CHECK_ACTION_ALTERNATIVE is active (value X)",
    "* we try also the oposite activity to VIEW_ACTION if the check",
    "* against the given activity was failed. The result of the granted",
    "* activity can be requested over the export parameter GRANTED_ACTVT.",
    "* If the authorization does not match for S_TABU_DIS or S_TABU_NAM",
    "* for one of the possible ACTVT -values the exception NO_AUTHORITY",
    "* will be raised",
    "* ---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "FORM check_s_tabu_dis_nam USING pd_actvt   TYPE xuval",
    "                                pd_group   TYPE tddat-cclass",
    "                                pd_table   TYPE dd25v-viewname",
    "                                pd_2nd_chk TYPE flag",
    "                       CHANGING pd_ret_act TYPE activ_auth.",
    "  CONSTANTS:",
    "    lc_true      TYPE sap_bool   VALUE 'X',",
    "    lc_failed    TYPE activ_auth VALUE '00',",
    "    lc_update    TYPE activ_auth VALUE '02',",
    "    lc_display   TYPE activ_auth VALUE '03'.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  pd_ret_act = lc_failed.",
    "",
    "  CASE pd_actvt.",
    "    WHEN lc_update.",
    "      AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_DIS'",
    "              ID 'ACTVT'     FIELD pd_actvt",
    "              ID 'DICBERCLS' FIELD pd_group.",
    "      IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "        pd_ret_act = pd_actvt.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ELSE.                       \"2nd try - with update and S_TABU_NAM",
    "        AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_NAM'",
    "              ID 'ACTVT'     FIELD pd_actvt",
    "              ID 'TABLE'     FIELD pd_table.",
    "        IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "          pd_ret_act = pd_actvt.  \"1st try for action was succesfull",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "      IF pd_2nd_chk = lc_true.",
    "        \"try to verify display auths for S_TABU_DIS",
    "        AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_DIS'",
    "             ID 'ACTVT'     FIELD lc_display",
    "             ID 'DICBERCLS' FIELD pd_group.",
    "        IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "          pd_ret_act = lc_display.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        \"if there are is no S_TABU_DIS diplay auth,",
    "        \"try S_TABU_NAM",
    "        AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_NAM'",
    "            ID 'ACTVT'     FIELD lc_display",
    "            ID 'TABLE'     FIELD pd_table.",
    "        IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "          pd_ret_act = lc_display.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "    WHEN lc_display.",
    "      AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_DIS'",
    "             ID 'ACTVT'     FIELD lc_display",
    "             ID 'DICBERCLS' FIELD pd_group.",
    "      IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "        pd_ret_act = lc_display.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      \"if the S_TABU_DIS check fails we have to try the same with",
    "      \"S_TABU_NAM ...",
    "      AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_NAM'",
    "             ID 'ACTVT'     FIELD lc_display",
    "             ID 'TABLE'     FIELD pd_table.",
    "      IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "        pd_ret_act = lc_display.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "      \"although we want to know display auth, we should verify the",
    "      \"same check on update level because update is also valid for",
    "      \"display",
    "      IF pd_2nd_chk = lc_true.",
    "        AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_DIS'",
    "               ID 'ACTVT'     FIELD lc_update",
    "               ID 'DICBERCLS' FIELD pd_group.",
    "        IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "          pd_ret_act = lc_update.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "",
    "        \"now process the alternative check for update auth",
    "        AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_NAM'",
    "               ID 'ACTVT'     FIELD lc_update",
    "               ID 'TABLE'     FIELD pd_table.",
    "        IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "          pd_ret_act = lc_update.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  ENDCASE.",
    "",
    "ENDFORM.                    \"check_s_tabu_dis_nam"
  ],
  "fingerprint": "8be3d1fce5d3d339043db92fbf0f3ad864fafd60bea30c4591659d68ea510847",
  "interfaceFingerprint": "18ad8eee7711075432161fd6f58fd997a4d1a7e2702379024482512986c36ef1",
  "sourceFingerprint": "7d4fd479dbeaead1bd179578506691a1991f9f8372948f86b997832c908c82aa"
}

schema.name: get_abap_object_lines
schema.description: Read active ABAP source and return the SHA-256 fingerprint of the complete untrimmed source. objectType disambiguates same-named objects. methodName extracts one method body from a class while retaining the complete-source fingerprint.

```abap
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
***INCLUDE LBFCRF01 .
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  CheckReferedCurrency
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  This routine gets currencydepending data by:
*  1. Checking the value of parameter for currency:
*     - if it is initial the currencie's decimal places will be assumed
*       with 2
*     - if it is not initial, currencie's decimals will be taken from
*       pool table TCURX.
*     If the access on TCURX fails, currencies decimals will be again
*     assumed as 2
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->PT_RETURN: Collection of all occured error situations
*      -->P_CURRENCY: Code for currency (TCURC-WAERS, TCURX-CURKEY)
*      -->P_AMOUNT_EXTERNAL: external amount that has to be converted
*      -->P_AMOUNT_INTERNAL: Field for result of conversion
*      <--PS_DECIMALS_OF_CURRENCY:structure: for information of decimals
*      <--PS_RETURN: Structure to return messages
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM checkreferedcurrency TABLES   pt_return STRUCTURE bapireturn
                          USING    p_currency
                                   p_amount_external
                          CHANGING p_amount_internal
                                   ps_decimals_of_currency TYPE tcurx
                                   ps_return.
  DATA: c_currency TYPE tcurc-waers,
        s_currency TYPE tcurc.

  MOVE p_currency TO c_currency.

*Check state of P_CURRENCY: Initial or not
  IF NOT c_currency IS INITIAL.
* Translate LV_CURRENCY for case sensitive acces on TCURC and TCURX
    SET LOCALE LANGUAGE sy-langu.
    TRANSLATE c_currency TO UPPER CASE.
  ELSE. "ERROR: No specified value in P_CURRENCY
    CALL FUNCTION 'BALW_BAPIRETURN_GET'
         EXPORTING
              type       = 'E'
              cl         = 'S&'                             "QWI300198
              number     = '043'
         IMPORTING
              bapireturn = ps_return
         EXCEPTIONS
              OTHERS     = 1.
    APPEND ps_return TO pt_return.

*  Set default value of 2 decimal places for standard converion
    MOVE 2 TO ps_decimals_of_currency-currdec.
  ENDIF. "Evaluation of P_CURRENCY: Initial or not

*Check existence of currency within the system by accessing table  on
*database (TCURC) for all valid currencies
  IF NOT c_currency IS INITIAL.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM  tcurc
                    INTO  s_currency
                    WHERE waers = c_currency.

    IF sy-subrc = 0. "Destinated currency was beeing defined
*  Get data from table TCURX which contains exceptions for number of
*  decimal places for all currencies beeing defined in the system
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM  tcurx
                      INTO  ps_decimals_of_currency
                      WHERE currkey = c_currency.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. "c_currency is a currency with 2 decimal places
        MOVE 2 TO ps_decimals_of_currency-currdec.
```

```abap
*       furthermore: unwrapping BCSets is not for 'PI-' !
*
    IF applk_wa(3) = 'EA-'
      OR applk_wa = 'JVA'
      OR applk_wa = 'IS-PS'.
      PERFORM fill_bcset TABLES bcset_ids
                         USING  applk_wa.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  DESCRIBE TABLE bcset_ids LINES nn.
  IF nn EQ 0.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  SORT: bcset_ids.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM bcset_ids.

  CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIVATE_BCSETS_REMOTE'
    EXPORTING
      activation_type        = 1
*     RFCDEST                = ' '
      system                 = sy-sysid
      mandant                = sy-mandt
      task_number_syst       = task
*     TASK_NUMBER_CUST       =
*     SIMULATION_ON          = ' '
*     REMOTE_TYPE            = 'S'
*     COMPLETE_ONLY          = 1
      WRITE_STATUS           = 'X'
    IMPORTING
      proto_handle           = proto_handle
      rc_activ               = rc_activ
    TABLES
      bcset_ids              = bcset_ids
*     VARIABLES              =
*   CHANGING
*     VARIABLES_NEW          =
    EXCEPTIONS
      no_authority           = 1
      no_bcset               = 2
      wrong_parameters       = 3
      no_rfc_authority       = 4
      rfc_failure            = 5
      internal_error         = 6
      OTHERS                 = 7.

  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE sy-msgty NUMBER sy-msgno
             WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.
  ENDIF.
  LOOP AT bcset_ids.
    CLEAR act_status.
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_DB_ACTSTATUS_READ'
      EXPORTING
        system_id           = sy-sysid
        mandant             = sy-mandt
        bcset               = bcset_ids-bcset_id
      IMPORTING
        act_status          = act_status
        act_nr              = proto_handle
*       ACT_USER            =
*       ACT_DATE            =
*       ACT_TIME            =
      EXCEPTIONS
        no_data_found       = 1
        OTHERS              = 2.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE sy-msgty NUMBER sy-msgno
               WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.
    else.
      CASE act_status.
       WHEN 'S' or 'I'.                         "successfully activated
       WHEN 'A' or 'D'.                         "activation terminated
          MESSAGE i100(b!) WITH bcset_ids-bcset_id.
       WHEN 'B'.                                     "activation started
          MESSAGE i101(b!) WITH bcset_ids-bcset_id.
       WHEN 'E'.                         "activation finished with error
          MESSAGE i102(b!) WITH bcset_ids-bcset_id.
       WHEN 'W'.                       "activation finished with warning
*       MESSAGE I103(b!) WITH bcset_ids-bcset_id.      "no real problem
       WHEN others.                          "unknown activation status
          MESSAGE i104(b!) WITH bcset_ids-bcset_id.
      ENDCASE.
    endif.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.  "bcset_activate.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  FORM FILL_BCSET
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  get all BC-Sets which are to be activated belonging to a certain
*  activation switch
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fill_bcset TABLES pt_bcset_ids STRUCTURE scpr_parnt
                USING  p_applk     TYPE applk_type.
  DATA: l_applk TYPE applk_bf.
  l_applk = p_applk-applk.
  SELECT bcset_id FROM eabcsets APPENDING TABLE pt_bcset_ids
  WHERE applk = p_applk.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    REFRESH pt_bcset_ids.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                    "FILL_BCSET
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  modify_screen
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Change field attributes, e.g. output only
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM modify_screen .

FIELD-SYMBOLS: <extr_wa> TYPE tbe11.
  ASSIGN: extract TO <extr_wa> CASTING.

  CHECK status-action EQ aendern.
  LOOP AT SCREEN.

    IF  screen-name = 'TBE11-AKTIV'.
      IF  <extr_wa>-applk    = 'IS-PS'
       or <extr_wa>-applk    = 'JVA'
       or <extr_wa>-applk(3) = 'EA-'.
        screen-input = '0'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    MODIFY SCREEN.

  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.                    " modify_screen
```

```abap
FORM on_save_tbe11.
  DATA: l_work_area          TYPE tbe11,
        l_switch             TYPE bbte_ext_switch,
        l_activation_allowed TYPE boolean.

  CLEAR gt_switch.
  LOOP AT total.
    l_work_area = total.
    IF   l_work_area-applk(3) = 'EA-'
      OR l_work_area-applk(3) = 'PI-'
      OR l_work_area-applk = 'IS-PS'
      OR l_work_area-applk = 'JVA'.
      IF NOT (
            <action> = geloescht
        AND l_work_area-aktiv = space
        OR  <action> = original
        OR  <action> = neuer_geloescht ).

*       check, if activation is allowed
        CLEAR l_activation_allowed.
        IF NOT g_extension_exit IS INITIAL.

          CLEAR sy-msgid.
*         call of BAdI
          CALL METHOD g_extension_exit->activation_change
            EXPORTING
              active             = l_work_area-aktiv
              flt_val            = l_work_area-applk
            EXCEPTIONS
              change_not_allowed = 1.

          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
*           -> don't change activation of extension!!
            IF NOT sy-msgid IS INITIAL.
              MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE sy-msgty NUMBER sy-msgno
                    WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.
            ELSE.
              MESSAGE e041(b!).
            ENDIF.
          ELSE.
            l_activation_allowed = 'X'.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          l_activation_allowed = 'X'.
        ENDIF.

        IF NOT l_activation_allowed IS INITIAL.
*         collect activation changes
*         (notification is done after the changes are saved on DB)
          l_switch-ext_alias = l_work_area-applk.
          IF l_work_area-aktiv = space.
            CLEAR l_switch-switch.
          ELSE.
            l_switch-switch    = 'X'.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND l_switch TO gt_switch.
        ENDIF.

      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.
* Prepare BC-Set activation in event 01
  PERFORM bcset_activate_prepare.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM bcset_activate_prepare.

  CONSTANTS: c_aktiv(5) TYPE c VALUE 'AKTIV',
             c_applk(5) TYPE c VALUE 'APPLK'.
  DATA: applk TYPE applk_bf, ii TYPE i.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS:  <aktiv> TYPE aktiv_ak,
                  <applk> TYPE applk_bf.

  REFRESH activate_applk.

  LOOP AT total.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT c_aktiv OF STRUCTURE <vim_total_struc> TO <aktiv>.

    IF <action> EQ aendern.                               "note 1466156

*---------------Authorithy check for BC-Set activation-----------------*
*     In that case bc-set activation necessary -> check authorithy
*       Correction "HCG August 2003 due to customer issue 594389

      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_AUTHORITY_CHECK'
        EXPORTING
          TASK             = 'ACTIVATE'
        EXCEPTIONS
          WRONG_PARAMETERS = 1
          NO_AUTHORITY     = 2
          OTHERS           = 3.
      case sy-subrc.
        when 0.
        when 1.
          message e273(SCPR).
        when 2.
          CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_AUTHORITY_CHECK'
            EXPORTING
              TASK             = 'ACTUNCHKT'            "Expert mode
            EXCEPTIONS
              WRONG_PARAMETERS = 1
              NO_AUTHORITY     = 2
              OTHERS           = 3.
          case sy-subrc.
            when 0.
            when 1.
              message e273(SCPR).
            when 2.
              message e247(SCPR) with sy-uname sy-sysid sy-mandt.
            when others.
              message e320(SCPR).
          endcase.
        when others.
          message e320(SCPR).
      endcase.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
      IF <aktiv> = 'X'.                                   "note 1466156

        ASSIGN COMPONENT c_applk OF STRUCTURE <vim_total_struc> TO <applk>.
        applk = <applk>.
        APPEND applk TO activate_applk.

      ELSEIF <aktiv> = space.                             "note 1466156

*      <aktiv> = 'X'.                   "Deactivation not possible
*      MODIFY total.
*      MESSAGE i105(b!).

      ENDIF.                                              "note 1466156

    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  LOOP AT extract.
   ASSIGN COMPONENT c_aktiv OF STRUCTURE <vim_extract_struc> TO <aktiv>.
    IF <xact> EQ aendern AND <aktiv> = 'X'.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT c_applk OF STRUCTURE <vim_extract_struc> TO
                                                                <applk>.
      applk = <applk>.
      APPEND applk TO activate_applk.
    ELSEIF <xact> EQ aendern AND <aktiv> = space.
*      <aktiv> = 'X'.                     "Deactivation not possible
*      MODIFY extract.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  ii = 4.
  LOOP AT total.
    IF <action> = 'U'
    or <action> = 'N'
    or <action> = 'D'.
      ii = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  sy-subrc = ii.                           "0: Save; 4: Nothing to save

ENDFORM. "bcset_activate_prepare.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
```

```abap
      CHECK total_s-line+8(3) NE <land>
      OR    total_s-line+11(6) NE <applk>.
      MESSAGE e021(b!) WITH <procs>.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.
```

  ],
  "source": [
    "FUNCTION view_enqueue.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Globale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"       IMPORTING",
    "*\"             VALUE(ACTION) DEFAULT 'E'",
    "*\"             VALUE(ENQUEUE_MODE) DEFAULT 'S'",
    "*\"             VALUE(VIEW_NAME) LIKE  OCUS-TABLE",
    "*\"             VALUE(ENQUEUE_RANGE) DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"       TABLES",
    "*\"              SELLIST STRUCTURE  VIMSELLIST OPTIONAL",
    "*\"       EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"              CLIENT_REFERENCE",
    "*\"              FOREIGN_LOCK",
    "*\"              INVALID_ACTION",
    "*\"              INVALID_ENQUEUE_MODE",
    "*\"              SYSTEM_FAILURE",
    "*\"              TABLE_NOT_FOUND",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  DATA: tabkey   LIKE rstable-varkey,",
    "        exclusive TYPE c VALUE 'E',",
    "        shared    TYPE c VALUE 'S',",
    "        enqueue   TYPE c VALUE 'E',",
    "        dequeue   TYPE c VALUE 'D',",
    "        n TYPE c VALUE 'N',",
    "        index LIKE sy-tabix, rc LIKE sy-subrc, rollback_action,",
    "*     GEN_ENQUEUE_PATTERN(2) TYPE C VALUE ' @'.",
    "        BEGIN OF tabkeys_safe OCCURS 10,",
    "          tabname LIKE rstable-tabname,",
    "          tabkey LIKE rstable-varkey,",
    "        END OF tabkeys_safe,",
    "        tab_name LIKE ocus-table.",
    "  DATA: viewfields_local TYPE ddfields.",
    "",
    "  IF action NE enqueue AND action NE dequeue.",
    "    RAISE invalid_action.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF enqueue_mode NE exclusive AND enqueue_mode NE shared.",
    "    RAISE invalid_enqueue_mode.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF last_view NE view_name.",
    "* get nametab-info",
    "    PERFORM prepare USING view_name.",
    "    last_view = view_name.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  REFRESH viewfields_local.",
    "  APPEND LINES OF viewfields TO viewfields_local.",
    "  IF last_enq_mode EQ space AND tvdir-bastab EQ space",
    "                            AND viewvari_of_tab = space.       \"Subviews",
    "    MOVE shared TO last_enq_mode.",
    "    IF last_dd26v_view NE view_name.",
    "      PERFORM get_dd26v USING view_name.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF enqueue_mode EQ exclusive AND last_enq_mode NE exclusive",
    "                               AND tvdir-bastab  EQ space",
    "                               AND viewvari_of_tab = space.    \"Subviews",
    "    MOVE enqueue_mode TO last_enq_mode.",
    "    IF last_enqtab_view NE view_name.",
    "      PERFORM fill_enqtab USING view_name.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF last_keyfields_view NE view_name.",
    "* fill keyfield-list",
    "    IF tvdir-bastab <> space AND text_tab_exists <> space.",
    "* add text key if necessary",
    "      READ TABLE viewfields_local WITH KEY tabname = text_table_name",
    "       TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        APPEND LINES OF textfields TO viewfields_local.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    PERFORM fill_keyfields USING view_name",
    "                                 viewfields_local.",
    "    IF enqueue_mode EQ exclusive AND tvdir-bastab EQ space",
    "                                 AND viewvari_of_tab = space.  \"Subviews",
    "      CLEAR last_dd26v_view.",
    "      FREE: dd26v_tab, dd26v,",
    "            dd02l.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF action EQ enqueue.",
    "    rollback_action = dequeue.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    rollback_action = enqueue.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF tvdir-bastab NE space OR             \"force bastab",
    "     viewvari_of_tab <> space.                                 \"Subviews",
    "    IF viewvari_of_tab <> space.                            \"Subviews ..",
    "      tab_name = mview_roottab.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      tab_name = view_name.",
    "    ENDIF.                                                  \".. Subviews",
    "    PERFORM fill_tabkey USING tab_name tabkey.",
    "    tabkeys_safe-tabname = tab_name. tabkeys_safe-tabkey = tabkey.",
    "    APPEND tabkeys_safe.",
    "    PERFORM enqueue_tab USING tab_name tabkey",
    "                              enqueue_mode action.",
    "    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "      IF text_tab_exists NE space.",
    "* if entity table is client dependent, text tab must be cl. dep. too",
    "* --> use same TABKEY",
    "        PERFORM fill_tabkey USING text_table_name tabkey.",
    "        PERFORM enqueue_tab USING text_table_name tabkey",
    "                                  enqueue_mode action.",
    "        IF sy-subrc NE 0.",
    "* data could'nt be locked -> dequeue already locked data",
    "          MOVE sy-subrc TO rc.",
    "          READ TABLE tabkeys_safe WITH KEY tabname = tab_name.",
    "*         PERFORM ENQUEUE_TAB USING VIEW_NAME TABKEY",
    "          PERFORM enqueue_tab USING tab_name tabkeys_safe-tabkey",
    "                                    enqueue_mode rollback_action.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      MOVE sy-subrc TO rc.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ELSE.                           \"view",
    "    IF enqueue_mode EQ exclusive.",
    "      LOOP AT enqueue_table WHERE enqmode NE n.",
    "*       IF ENQUEUE_TABLE-CLIDEP NE SPACE.",
    "*         MOVE SY-MANDT TO TABKEY.",
    "*       ELSE.",
    "*         CLEAR TABKEY.",
    "*       ENDIF.",
    "*       TRANSLATE TABKEY USING GEN_ENQUEUE_PATTERN.",
    "        PERFORM fill_tabkey USING enqueue_table-tabname tabkey.",
    "        tabkeys_safe-tabname = enqueue_table-tabname.",
    "        tabkeys_safe-tabkey = tabkey.",
    "        APPEND tabkeys_safe.",
    "        PERFORM enqueue_tab USING enqueue_table-tabname tabkey",
    "                                  enqueue_table-enqmode action.",
    "        IF sy-subrc NE 0.",
    "* data could'nt be locked -> dequeue already locked data",
    "          MOVE sy-subrc TO rc.",
    "          LOOP AT enqueue_table TO index WHERE enqmode NE n.",
    "*           IF ENQUEUE_TABLE-CLIDEP NE SPACE.",
    "*             MOVE SY-MANDT TO TABKEY.",
    "*           ELSE.",
    "*             CLEAR TABKEY.",
    "*           ENDIF.",
    "*           TRANSLATE TABKEY USING GEN_ENQUEUE_PATTERN.",
    "            READ TABLE tabkeys_safe WITH KEY",
    "                                       tabname = enqueue_table-tabname.",
    "*           PERFORM ENQUEUE_TAB USING ENQUEUE_TABLE-TABNAME TABKEY",
    "            PERFORM enqueue_tab USING enqueue_table-tabname",
    "                                      tabkeys_safe-tabkey",
    "                                  enqueue_table-enqmode rollback_action.",
    "          ENDLOOP.",
    "          EXIT.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        MOVE sy-tabix TO index.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      LOOP AT dd02l_tab.",
    "*       IF DD02L_TAB-CLIDEP NE SPACE.",
    "*         MOVE SY-MANDT TO TABKEY.",
    "*       ELSE.",
    "*         CLEAR TABKEY.",
    "*       ENDIF.",
    "*       TRANSLATE TABKEY USING GEN_ENQUEUE_PATTERN.",
    "        PERFORM fill_tabkey USING dd02l_tab-tabname tabkey.",
    "        tabkeys_safe-tabname = dd02l_tab-tabname.",
    "        tabkeys_safe-tabkey = tabkey.",
    "        APPEND tabkeys_safe.",
    "        PERFORM enqueue_tab USING dd02l_tab-tabname tabkey",
    "                                  enqueue_mode action.",
    "        IF sy-subrc NE 0.",
    "* data could'nt be locked -> dequeue already locked data",
    "          MOVE sy-subrc TO rc.",
    "          LOOP AT dd02l_tab TO index.",
    "*           IF DD02L_TAB-CLIDEP NE SPACE.",
    "*             MOVE SY-MANDT TO TABKEY.",
    "*           ELSE.",
    "*             CLEAR TABKEY.",
    "*           ENDIF.",
    "*           TRANSLATE TABKEY USING GEN_ENQUEUE_PATTERN.",
    "            READ TABLE tabkeys_safe WITH KEY",
    "                                       tabname = dd02l_tab-tabname.",
    "*           PERFORM ENQUEUE_TAB USING DD02L_TAB-TABNAME TABKEY",
    "            PERFORM enqueue_tab USING dd02l_tab-tabname",
    "                                      tabkeys_safe-tabkey",
    "                                      enqueue_mode rollback_action.",
    "          ENDLOOP.",
    "          EXIT.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        MOVE sy-tabix TO index.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  CASE rc.",
    "    WHEN 1. RAISE foreign_lock.",
    "    WHEN 2. RAISE system_failure.",
    "  ENDCASE.",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],

```abap
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form X_CALL_VIEWMAINTENANCE                                   *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* external call of view maintenance                                   *
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* --> XCV_USE_LCL_TBL:  'X' Datencontainer XCV_TOTAL und XCV_EXTRACT
*                       sind nicht struktueriert und nicht vom Typ X
*                       => Daten müssen in lokale Container umgesetzt
*                       werden.
* --> XCV_IMP_SPECMODE: 'P' Profilimport/
*                       'T' Testmodus Import/'F' Forcemodus Import /
*                       'B' T + F Import
*&--------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM x_call_viewmaintenance USING
                                value(xcv_use_lcl_tbl) LIKE tvdir-flag
                                value(xcv_import) LIKE tvdir-flag
                                xcv_corrnbr LIKE e070-trkorr
                                value(xcv_fcode) TYPE vimty_tcode
                                value(xcv_action) LIKE tvdir-flag
                                value(xcv_name) TYPE vimty_tablename
                                value(xcv_tot_name) TYPE c
                                value(xcv_ext_name) TYPE c
                                value(xcv_upgr_dest) LIKE rfcdes-rfcdest
                                value(xcv_upgr_clnt) LIKE sy-mandt
                                xcv_upd_requ LIKE tvdir-flag
                                xcv_e071k TYPE table
                                xcv_dba_sel TYPE table
                                xcv_dpl_sel TYPE table
                                xcv_excufc TYPE table
                                xcv_extract TYPE table
                                xcv_total TYPE table
                                xcv_header TYPE table
                                xcv_namtab TYPE table
                                xcv_last_command TYPE vimty_tcode
                                xcv_last_act_entry LIKE sy-tabix
                                xcv_results LIKE vimmodres
                                xcv_imp_results TYPE slctr_tables_keys
                                value(xcv_imp_specmode) LIKE tvdir-flag
                                value(xcv_cmp_slcnds) LIKE tvdir-flag.

  DATA: xcv_return TYPE i, xcv_i_fcode TYPE vimty_tcode,                   "#EC NEEDED
        line_name(30) TYPE c, length TYPE i, tabtype TYPE ob_typ,
        header_wa_loc TYPE vimdesc,
        BEGIN OF tabline,
          line(4096) TYPE c,
        END OF tabline.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <total> TYPE table, <extract> TYPE table,
                 <tabline> TYPE ANY, <tabline_x> TYPE x,
                 <tabline2> TYPE ANY, <tabline2_x> TYPE x,
                 <header> TYPE vimdesc.
  LOCAL: vim_import_mode_active, vim_no_dialog, vim_import_testmode,
         vim_import_forcemode.          "SW  wg. Rekurs. im Cluster

  vim_no_dialog = xcv_import. TRANSLATE vim_no_dialog USING 'H DX'.
  IF xcv_imp_specmode = 'P'.           "Profilimp
    vim_import_profile = 'X'.
  ENDIF.
  vim_import_testmode = xcv_imp_specmode.
  TRANSLATE vim_import_testmode USING 'TXBXF P '.
  vim_import_forcemode = xcv_imp_specmode.
  TRANSLATE vim_import_forcemode USING 'T BXFXP '.
  IF xcv_use_lcl_tbl NE space.
    ASSIGN: (xcv_tot_name) TO <total>, (xcv_ext_name) TO <extract>.
    IF xcv_use_lcl_tbl NE 'L'.         "use not _only_ local tables
      READ TABLE xcv_header ASSIGNING <header> CASTING INDEX 1.
      IF <header>-bastab NE space AND <header>-texttbexst NE space.
        length = <header>-after_tabc + <header>-aft_txttbc
                 + 3 * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.
      ELSE.
        length = <header>-after_tabc
                 + 2 * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.
      ENDIF.
      SEARCH xcv_tot_name FOR '[' IN CHARACTER MODE.
      MOVE xcv_tot_name(sy-fdpos) TO line_name.
      ASSIGN: (line_name) TO <tabline2>,
              <tabline2> TO <tabline2_x> CASTING.
      REFRESH: <total>, <extract>.
      LOOP AT xcv_total ASSIGNING <tabline>.
        ASSIGN <tabline> TO <tabline_x> CASTING.
        MOVE <tabline_x> TO <tabline2_x>(length).
        APPEND <tabline2> TO <total>.
      ENDLOOP.
      LOOP AT xcv_extract ASSIGNING <tabline>.
        ASSIGN <tabline> TO <tabline_x> CASTING.
        MOVE <tabline_x> TO <tabline2_x>(length).
        APPEND <tabline2> TO <extract>.
      ENDLOOP.
*      <total> = xcv_total. <extract> = xcv_extract.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    ASSIGN: xcv_total TO <total>, xcv_extract TO <extract>.
  ENDIF.
  vim_import_mode_active = xcv_import. xcv_i_fcode = xcv_fcode.
  IF xcv_import NE space AND xcv_fcode NE 'SAVE'.
  ELSEIF xcv_import NE space AND xcv_fcode EQ 'SAVE'.       "SW
    imp_results[] = xcv_imp_results[].                      "SW
  ELSEIF xcv_fcode EQ 'INS' OR xcv_fcode EQ 'DEL' OR
         xcv_fcode EQ 'UPD' OR xcv_fcode EQ 'SHOW'.
    vim_single_entry_function = xcv_fcode. xcv_i_fcode = 'EDIT'.
  ENDIF.
  IF xcv_import EQ 'D' AND xcv_fcode EQ 'SAVE'.
    vim_import_no_message = 'X'.
  ENDIF.
  CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_MAINTENANCE_LOW_LEVEL'
    EXPORTING
      corr_number                 = xcv_corrnbr
      fcode                       = xcv_i_fcode
      view_action                 = xcv_action
      view_name                   = xcv_name
      rfc_destination_for_upgrade = xcv_upgr_dest
      client_for_upgrade          = xcv_upgr_clnt
      complex_selconds_used       = xcv_cmp_slcnds
    IMPORTING
      last_act_entry              = xcv_last_act_entry
      ucomm                       = xcv_last_command
      update_required             = xcv_upd_requ
      corr_number                 = xcv_corrnbr
    TABLES
      corr_keytab                 = xcv_e071k
      dba_sellist                 = xcv_dba_sel
      dpl_sellist                 = xcv_dpl_sel
      excl_cua_funct              = xcv_excufc
      extract                     = <extract>
      total                       = <total>
      x_header                    = xcv_header
      x_namtab                    = xcv_namtab
    EXCEPTIONS
      function_not_found          = 1
      missing_corr_number         = 2
      no_value_for_subset_ident   = 3
      saving_correction_failed    = 4.
*  IF xcv_import NE space AND
*     ( sy-subrc NE 0 OR
*       xcv_fcode EQ save AND <status>-upd_flag NE space ).
* "HCG BC-Set: sy-subrc NE 0 -> always error message in log
  IF ( xcv_import NE space OR vim_import_profile NE space ) AND
     ( sy-subrc NE 0 OR
       xcv_fcode EQ save AND <status>-upd_flag NE space ).
    IF sy-msgid NE space.
```

```abap
FORM vim_set_init_from_sellist USING    p_tabname TYPE tabname
                                        p_namtab LIKE x_namtab[]

  DATA: count TYPE i, h_ix TYPE i, rcode TYPE xfeld,                     "#EC NEEDED

        EXCEPTIONS
```

      }
    ]
  }
}

schema.name: read_function_module_interface
schema.description: Read one active function module interface and source through the SAP repository helper. Read-only and allowed for customer or standard function modules. Preserves raw updateTaskMode; updateTask is true for any noninitial update mode, including numeric SAP modes, not only X. Mode validity/meaning is not inferred. Returns a deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint; includeExecutionSupport additionally resolves scalar, flat-structure, and table parameter shapes through DDIC.

content.text:
{
  "connectionId": "w200",
  "functionName": "VIEW_GET_DDIC_INFO",
  "functionGroup": "SVIX",
  "shortText": "Fill view maintenance control block table",
  "remoteMode": "",
  "updateTask": false,
  "updateTaskMode": "",
  "globalInterface": true,
  "remoteEnabled": false,
  "importParameters": [
    {
      "name": "VIEWNAME",
      "typeName": "OCUS-TABLE",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "Name of the view/table to be edited"
    },
    {
      "name": "VARIANT_FOR_SELECTION",
      "typeName": "TVIMV-VARIANT",
      "optional": true,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "Selection conditions variant"
    }
  ],
  "exportParameters": [],
  "changingParameters": [],
  "tableParameters": [
    {
      "name": "SELLIST",
      "typeName": "VIMSELLIST",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": false,
      "description": "Selection conditions table"
    },
    {
      "name": "X_HEADER",
      "typeName": "VIMDESC",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": false,
      "description": "View/table control block table"
    },
    {
      "name": "X_NAMTAB",
      "typeName": "VIMNAMTAB",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": false,
      "description": "View fields control block table"
    }
  ],
  "exceptions": [
    {
      "name": "NO_TVDIR_ENTRY",
      "description": "View/table is not entered in TVDIR"
    },
    {
      "name": "TABLE_NOT_FOUND",
      "description": "View/table not found in DDIC"
    }
  ],
  "source": [
    "FUNCTION view_get_ddic_info.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Globale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(VIEWNAME) LIKE  OCUS-TABLE",
    "*\"     VALUE(VARIANT_FOR_SELECTION) LIKE  TVIMV-VARIANT DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      SELLIST STRUCTURE  VIMSELLIST",
    "*\"      X_HEADER STRUCTURE  VIMDESC",
    "*\"      X_NAMTAB STRUCTURE  VIMNAMTAB",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      NO_TVDIR_ENTRY",
    "*\"      TABLE_NOT_FOUND",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  DATA: sel TYPE xfeld, new_line_in_sel TYPE xfeld,",
    "        tmp_namtab LIKE vimnamtab,",
    "        offset LIKE ocus-tablen, h0(14) TYPE x,",
    "        old_tabname LIKE dd28v-tabname,",
    "        old_fieldname LIKE dd28v-fieldname,",
    "        rc LIKE sy-subrc, date_fld(1) TYPE c,",
    "        hk     VALUE '''', other_date_hidden(1) TYPE c,",
    "        ix LIKE sy-tabix, itvimv LIKE tvimv OCCURS 10 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "        maint_x030l LIKE x030l,        \"Subviews ..",
    "        x031l_tab LIKE x031l OCCURS 10 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "        viewfields_save LIKE dfies OCCURS 10 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "*        dd27v_maint LIKE dd27v OCCURS 10 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "*        dd27v_save LIKE dd27v OCCURS 10 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "*        dd25v_maint type dd25v,",
    "        dd27p_maint TYPE TABLE OF dd27p WITH HEADER LINE",
    "         INITIAL SIZE 50,",
    "        save_tvdir_bastab(1) TYPE c,",
    "        hidden_field(1) TYPE c,        \"Feld ist auszublenden",
    "        orig_viewgrant(1) TYPE c,",
    "        state_tab_index LIKE sy-tabix, \".. Subviews",
    "        dummyvalue LIKE vimsellist-value, iflag(1) TYPE c,",
    "        x030l_dummy TYPE x030l,",
    "        max_trsp_keylen TYPE i,",
    "        dd02v_roottab TYPE dd02v,                     \"HCG 13.09.02",
    "        w_vc_dd25v TYPE dd25v.   \"view-cluster header-table.",
    "  \"XB int4434083 2001",
    "",
    "  DATA maxtr_tmp TYPE i.",
    "  DATA: BEGIN OF viewfields_key,",
    "          tabname LIKE dfies-tabname,",
    "          fieldname LIKE dfies-fieldname,",
    "          langu     LIKE sy-langu,",
    "        END OF viewfields_key.",
    "  DATA: BEGIN OF viewfields_key_s,",
    "          tabname LIKE dfies-tabname,",
    "          fieldname LIKE dfies-fieldname,",
    "        END OF viewfields_key_s.",
    "",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <hf>.",
    "",
    "  PERFORM set_constants_get_ddic_info.",
    "  CLEAR: x_header, x_namtab, sellist.",
    "  REFRESH: x_namtab, sellist.",
    "* Get header entry",
    "***********************************************************************",
    "  IF viewname NE last_tvdir_view or viewname is initial. \"20041228 UF",
    "    PERFORM read_tvdir USING viewname CHANGING maintview.",
    "    SELECT * FROM tvimf INTO TABLE tvimf_tab WHERE tabname EQ maintview.",
    "    \"Subviews",
    "    last_tvdir_view = viewname.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "* Get nametab info",
    "***********************************************************************",
    "  IF viewname NE last_view.",
    "    save_tvdir_bastab = tvdir-bastab.  \"Subviews ..",
    "    IF tvdir-bastab = 'X' AND viewname <> maintview.",
    "*     Viewvariante auf Tabelle -> in PREPARE wie View zu behandeln!",
    "      CLEAR tvdir-bastab.",
    "    ENDIF.                             \".. Subviews",
    "    PERFORM prepare USING viewname.",
    "    last_view = viewname.",
    "    tvdir-bastab = save_tvdir_bastab.                       \"Subviews",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  PERFORM get_fieldtab USING viewname",
    "                       CHANGING x030l",
    "                                viewfields[]",
    "                                textfields[].",
    "  IF maintview = viewname.             \"Subviews ..",
    "* view or table",
    "    maint_x030l = x030l.               \"gesetzt in PREPARE -> READ_DDIC",
    "  ELSE.",
    "* view variant",
    "    viewfields_save[] = viewfields[].",
    "    PERFORM get_main_fieldtab USING maintview",
    "                              CHANGING maint_x030l",
    "                                       viewfields[].",
    "    IF maint_x030l-tabtype = view_tab.",
    "* variant of a maintenance view",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_VIEW_GET'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          name      = maintview",
    "          langu     = sy-langu",
    "        IMPORTING",
    "          dd25v_wa  = w_dd25v",
    "        TABLES",
    "          dd27p_tab = dd27p_maint[].",
    "      mview_roottab = w_dd25v-roottab.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "* variant of a table",
    "*     Vorbedingung für GET_FIELD_TAB für MAINTVIEW:",
    "      READ TABLE state_tab WITH KEY maintview BINARY SEARCH.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        state_tab_index = sy-tabix.",
    "        CLEAR state_tab.",
    "        state_tab-name = maintview.",
    "        state_tab-bastab = 'X'.",
    "        IF text_tab_exists = 'X'.      \"Subview beinhaltet Texttabelle",
    "          MOVE text_table_name TO state_tab-texttbname.",
    "          MOVE 'X' TO state_tab-texttbexst.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        INSERT state_tab INDEX state_tab_index.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      PERFORM get_fieldtab USING maintview  \"setzt glob. Var. VIEWFIELDS",
    "                           CHANGING x030l_dummy",
    "                                    viewfields[]",
    "                                    textfields[].",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.                               \".. Subviews",
    "  MOVE master_fpool TO x_header-gui_prog.",
    "* Fill X_HEADER",
    "  max_trsp_keylen",
    "   = vim_max_trsp_keylength * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "* 1. Get events",
    "***********************************************************************",
    "  LOOP AT tvimf_tab.",
    "    CASE tvimf_tab-event.",
    "      WHEN '01'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_sav.",
    "      WHEN '02'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_sav.",
    "      WHEN '03'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_del.",
    "      WHEN '04'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_del.",
    "      WHEN '05'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_on_new.",
    "      WHEN '06'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_org.",
    "      WHEN '07'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_rpl.",
    "      WHEN '08'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_rpl.",
    "      WHEN '09'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_on_org.",
    "      WHEN '10'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_e071.",
    "      WHEN '11'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_e071ks.",
    "      WHEN '12'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_e071ka.",
    "      WHEN '13'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_end.",
    "      WHEN '14'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_enq.",
    "      WHEN '15'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_udl.",
    "      WHEN '16'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_udl.",
    "      WHEN '17'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_prn.",
    "      WHEN '18'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_chk.",
    "      WHEN '19'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_ini.",
    "      WHEN '20'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_in_dss.",
    "      WHEN '21'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_h_flds.",
    "      WHEN '22'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_tltext.",
    "      WHEN '23'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_adr.",
    "      WHEN '24'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_dlm.",
    "      WHEN '25'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_on_aut.",
    "      WHEN '26'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_alv.\"UF",
    "      WHEN '27'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_uid.\"UF",
    "      WHEN 'AA'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_rp_get.",
    "      WHEN 'AB'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_rp_upd.",
    "      WHEN 'AC'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_rp_org.",
    "      WHEN 'AD'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_rp_cpl.",
    "      WHEN 'AE'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_rp_pos.",
    "      WHEN 'AF'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_tl_get.\"SW",
    "      WHEN 'AG'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_tl_org.\"SW",
    "      WHEN 'AH'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_tl_upd.\"SW",
    "      WHEN 'AI'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_alv.\"UF",
    "      WHEN 'ST'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-gui_prog.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "  ENDLOOP.",
    "* Fill X_HEADER",
    "***********************************************************************",
    "  MOVE-CORRESPONDING tvdir TO x_header.",
    "  PERFORM get_fpoolname USING    x_header-area              \"Fpoolname",
    "                        CHANGING x_header-fpoolname.",
    "  MOVE viewname TO x_header-viewname.  \"Subviews ..",
    "  MOVE maintview TO x_header-maintview.",
    "",
    "* maintenance flag from dd02l (dd02v) \"MF 2000-11-07",
    "  MOVE dd02v-mainflag TO x_header-mainflag.",
    "",
    "  CLEAR: x_header-generictrp, x_header-trgkeypos,",
    "         x_header-generictrp, x_header-trtxgkpos.",
    "  IF tvdir-bastab EQ space  OR maintview <> viewname.",
    "* get Table dd25v inhalt of ViewVariant. XB, int4434083 2001",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_VIEW_GET'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        name     = viewname",
    "        langu    = sy-langu",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "        dd25v_wa = w_vc_dd25v",
    "*   TABLES",
    "*     DD26V_TAB           =",
    "*     DD27P_TAB           =",
    "*     DD28J_TAB           =",
    "*     DD28V_TAB           =",
    ".",
    "* view- and table-variants",
    "* customauth of view empty -> take customauth of roottab \"HCG 13.11.02",
    "    IF w_dd25v-customauth IS INITIAL.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_GET'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          name          = mview_roottab",
    "          langu         = sy-langu",
    "        IMPORTING",
    "          dd02v_wa      = dd02v_roottab",
    "        EXCEPTIONS",
    "          illegal_input = 1",
    "          OTHERS        = 2.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        MESSAGE e029 WITH text_table_name RAISING table_not_found.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      MOVE dd02v_roottab-contflag TO w_dd25v-customauth.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    MOVE: w_vc_dd25v-ddtext     TO x_header-ddtext,",
    "          w_dd25v-customauth TO x_header-customauth,",
    "          w_dd25v-authclass  TO x_header-authclass,",
    "          mview_roottab    TO x_header-roottab,",
    "*         Pflegstatus von Viewcluster in Header schreiben, XB.",
    "          w_vc_dd25v-viewgrant  TO x_header-existency.",
    "*   Pflegestatus darf nur verschärft werden !",
    "    IF tvdir-bastab EQ space AND maintview <> viewname.",
    "* Vari auf View",
    "      SELECT viewgrant FROM dd25v INTO orig_viewgrant",
    "                              WHERE viewname = maintview.",
    "        EXIT.",
    "      ENDSELECT.",
    "      IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "        IF orig_viewgrant = 'R' OR",
    "           ( ( orig_viewgrant = 'U' OR orig_viewgrant = 'M' ) AND",
    "              w_dd25v-viewgrant  = space ).",
    "          x_header-existency = orig_viewgrant.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.                             \"Vari for view",
    "* Fill selection criteria (still variants)",
    "***********************************************************************",
    "    IF NOT dd28v_tab[] IS INITIAL.",
    "      MOVE 'X' TO x_header-selection.",
    "      MOVE 'X' TO sel.",
    "      LOOP AT dd28v_tab.",
    "        IF dd28v_tab-tabname NE old_tabname OR",
    "           dd28v_tab-fieldname NE old_fieldname.",
    "          MOVE: dd28v_tab-tabname TO old_tabname,",
    "                dd28v_tab-fieldname TO old_fieldname.",
    "          LOOP AT dd27p_tab WHERE tabname EQ dd28v_tab-tabname",
    "                              AND fieldname EQ dd28v_tab-fieldname.",
    "            EXIT.",
    "          ENDLOOP.",
    "          MOVE sy-subrc TO rc.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        CHECK rc EQ 0.",
    "        MOVE: dd27p_tab-viewfield TO sellist-viewfield,",
    "              dd27p_tab-viewfield TO viewfields_key-fieldname,",
    "              x_header-maintview  TO viewfields_key-tabname,\"Subviews",
    "              sy-langu            TO viewfields_key-langu,",
    "              'X' TO sellist-ddic.",
    "        READ TABLE viewfields WITH KEY viewfields_key.",
    "        IF sy-subrc NE 0.",
    "          CLEAR viewfields_key-langu.  \"Langu field possibly empty  \"HCG",
    "          READ TABLE viewfields WITH KEY viewfields_key.",
    "          IF sy-subrc NE 0.\"HCG Better to read any language than nothing",
    "            viewfields_key_s-tabname = viewfields_key-tabname.",
    "            viewfields_key_s-fieldname = viewfields_key-fieldname.",
    "            READ TABLE viewfields WITH KEY viewfields_key_s.",
    "          ENDIF.              \"HCG HW690816 Customer Message 436839 2003",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        IF dd28v_tab-constants(1) EQ hk.",
    "* literal",
    "*Changed by ACHACHADI on 14 Nov 2008",
    "          IF strlen( dd28v_tab-constants+2(*) ) EQ 0 .",
    "            ASSIGN space TO <hf>.",
    "          ELSEIF dd28v_tab-constants+1 CA hk.",
    "            ASSIGN dd28v_tab-constants+1(sy-fdpos) TO <hf>.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            ASSIGN dd28v_tab-constants+1(viewfields-outputlen) TO <hf>.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ELSEIF dd28v_tab-constants CO ' +-0123456789'.",
    "* number",
    "          ASSIGN dd28v_tab-constants(viewfields-outputlen) TO <hf>.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "* field name",
    "          ASSIGN (dd28v_tab-constants) TO <hf>.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        MOVE: dd28v_tab-negation  TO sellist-negation,",
    "              dd28v_tab-and_or    TO sellist-and_or,",
    "              dd28v_tab-operator  TO sellist-operator.",
    "        IF viewfields-inttype EQ 'C' AND viewfields-convexit EQ space.",
    "          MOVE <hf> TO sellist-value. CLEAR sy-subrc.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          dummyvalue = <hf>.",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_CONVERSION_OUTPUT'",
    "            EXPORTING",
    "              value_intern  = dummyvalue",
    "              inttype       = viewfields-inttype",
    "              datatype      = viewfields-datatype",
    "              decimals      = viewfields-decimals",
    "              convexit      = viewfields-convexit",
    "              sign          = viewfields-sign",
    "              outputlen     = viewfields-outputlen",
    "              intlen        = viewfields-intlen",
    "            IMPORTING",
    "              value_extern  = sellist-value",
    "            EXCEPTIONS",
    "              error_message = 1.",
    "          IF sy-subrc NE 0.            \"may be external format used?",
    "            MOVE <hf> TO sellist-value. iflag = 'X'.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_CONVERSION_INPUT'",
    "               EXPORTING",
    "                    value_extern   = sellist-value",
    "                    inttype        = viewfields-inttype",
    "                    datatype       = viewfields-datatype",
    "                    decimals       = viewfields-decimals",
    "                    convexit       = viewfields-convexit",
    "                    sign           = viewfields-sign",
    "                    outputlen      = viewfields-outputlen",
    "                    intlen         = viewfields-intlen",
    "                    lowercase      = viewfields-lowercase",
    "*                   DYNP_FIELDNAME = ' '",
    "                    no_status_set  = 'X'",
    "               IMPORTING",
    "                    value_intern   = dummyvalue",
    "               EXCEPTIONS",
    "                    error_message = 1.",
    "          IF sy-subrc NE 0 AND iflag EQ space. \"try original again...",
    "            MOVE <hf> TO sellist-value.",
    "            CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_CONVERSION_INPUT'",
    "                 EXPORTING",
    "                      value_extern   = sellist-value",
    "                      inttype        = viewfields-inttype",
    "                      datatype       = viewfields-datatype",
    "                      decimals       = viewfields-decimals",
    "                      convexit       = viewfields-convexit",
    "                      sign           = viewfields-sign",
    "                      outputlen      = viewfields-outputlen",
    "                      intlen         = viewfields-intlen",
    "                      lowercase      = viewfields-lowercase",
    "*                   DYNP_FIELDNAME = ' '",
    "                      no_status_set  = 'X'",
    "                 IMPORTING",
    "                      value_intern   = dummyvalue",
    "                 EXCEPTIONS",
    "                      error_message = 1.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          CLEAR iflag.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "          APPEND sellist.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "* table or view but no variant",
    "    MOVE: dd02v-ddtext    TO x_header-ddtext,",
    "          dd02v-contflag  TO x_header-customauth.",
    "  ENDIF.                               \"Subviews ..",
    "* length and offset info",
    "***********************************************************************",
    "  IF x030l-flagbyte O vim_clidep. MOVE 'X' TO x_header-clidep. ENDIF.",
    "  x_header-tablen = maint_x030l-tablen.",
    "* include alignment for character fields",
    "  PERFORM get_aligned_offset_char USING x_header-tablen",
    "                                  CHANGING x_header-after_tabc.",
    "  x_header-keylen = maint_x030l-keylen.",
    "  PERFORM get_aligned_offset_char USING x_header-keylen",
    "                                  CHANGING x_header-after_keyc.",
    "  IF x_header-keylen GT max_trsp_keylen.",
    "    x_header-generictrp = '$'.",
    "    x_header-maxtrkeyln = vim_max_trsp_keylength",
    "                          * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize",
    "                          - cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "    x_header-trgkeypos = vim_max_trsp_keylength",
    "                          * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize",
    "                          - cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "    IF x_header-genertxtrp EQ space.",
    "      x_header-genertxtrp = x_header-generictrp.",
    "      x_header-maxtrtxkln = x_header-maxtrkeyln.",
    "      x_header-trtxgkpos  = x_header-trgkeypos.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "* texttables",
    "  MOVE text_tab_exists TO x_header-texttbexst.",
    "  IF text_tab_exists NE space.",
    "    MOVE: text_x030l-tablen TO x_header-texttablen,",
    "          text_x030l-keylen TO x_header-textkeylen,",
    "          text_table_name TO x_header-texttab,",
    "          dd02v_txt-masterlang TO x_header-orig_lang.",
    "    PERFORM get_aligned_offset_char USING    x_header-texttablen",
    "                                    CHANGING x_header-aft_txttbc.",
    "    PERFORM get_aligned_offset_char USING    x_header-textkeylen",
    "                                    CHANGING x_header-aft_txtkc.",
    "    IF x_header-textkeylen GT max_trsp_keylen.",
    "      x_header-genertxtrp = '$'.",
    "      x_header-maxtrtxkln = vim_max_trsp_keylength",
    "                            * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize",
    "                            - cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "      x_header-trtxgkpos = vim_max_trsp_keylength",
    "                           * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize",
    "                           - cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF tvdir-bastab = 'X' AND text_x030l-flagbyte O vim_clidep.",
    "      MOVE 'X' TO x_header-textclidep.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "* Fill X_NAMTAB",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "  LOOP AT viewfields.",
    "    index = sy-tabix.                  \"Subviews ..",
    "    CLEAR hidden_field.",
    "* variants",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "    IF maintview <> viewname.    \"überprüfen, ob Feld im Subview ist",
    "      IF tvdir-bastab = 'X'.",
    "        x_header-fieldorder = 'X'.",
    "        IF text_tab_exists <> space AND viewfields-keyflag = 'X' AND",
    "           viewfields-tabname = text_table_name.",
    "          hidden_field = 'T'. CLEAR dd27p_tab.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          READ TABLE dd27p_tab WITH KEY tabname = viewfields-tabname",
    "                                      fieldname = viewfields-fieldname.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ELSE.",
    "        READ TABLE dd27p_maint INDEX index.",
    "        CHECK dd27p_maint-viewfield = viewfields-fieldname.",

    "      ELSEIF viewfields-scrtext_m NE space.",

    "        x_namtab-bastabname = dd27p_tab-tabname.",

    "      CASE dd27p_tab-rdonly.",
    "        WHEN rdonly.",
    "          MOVE 'X' TO x_header-rdonlyflag.",

    "      ENDCASE.",
    "      IF tvdir-bastab = space AND                           \"Subviews",
    "         dd27p_tab-rdonly EQ subset AND dd27p_tab-keyflag NE space AND",
    "                                       \"echtes Subset-Feld",
    "         ( maintview = viewname OR dd27p_maint-rdonly EQ subset ).",
    "      \"Subviews: Pflegedialog muß ebenfalls Subset-Eingenschaft besitzen",
    "        MOVE: 'X' TO x_header-selection,",

schema.name: read_ddic_structure
schema.description: Read one active SAP Dictionary structure, including component data elements, package, concurrency version, and SHA-256 definition fingerprint. An append structure is a structure whose tableClass is APPEND; for it the response also carries baseTable, the table it is attached to (empty for a plain structure). Read-only and allowed for customer or standard objects. A read that completes and finds nothing answers with status "not-found", exists false and authoritative true instead of failing, so a missing object is distinguishable from a broken helper; every other failure is still reported as an error.
